data.one_liner: A list widget that endlessly scrolls over a limited set of items like a roller.
data.what_it_does: Provides a list of values distributed in a circle where a user can scroll endlessly in one direction over a limited and repeated set of items. It allows handling selection changes and supports programmatic scrolling.
use_when: Implementing picker widgets with repeating limited options
Creating piano notes selection or slot-like selectors
avoid_when: You need a standard long or infinite list with distinct non-repeating items
You require complex heterogenous layouts not suited for repeating roller slots
strengths: Endless scrolling over limited sets of items
Supports programmatic scrolling and scroll direction locks
Easy integration with standard widget lists
weaknesses: Limited use cases outside of selectors and time/value pickers
Relies on a small set of dependencies including infinite_listview
